summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter per the spec. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, indent 4 per level, unchanged max_width). rich/align.py adds VerticalCenter (render, measure, repr, JupyterMixin), Align.__repr__, and the Align width constraint (measured maximum, or min with explicit width). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added section (two entries). Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render, newline count, tall content, measurement) and tests/test_tree.py (tree measurement expecting Measurement(11, 19)). Per instructions, no tests were run and nothing was committed; all verification was by reading the code. One unrequested extra test (tall content) was added.
